insights.title: Cross-benchmark AUROC near chance
insights.detail: Cross-benchmark AUROC of 0.515 is barely above chance (0.5). Features learned on one benchmark don't transfer to another.
insights.recommendation: Try contrastive_cross_benchmark to find shared RH direction.

insights.title: Joint probe much better than cross-benchmark
insights.detail: Joint probe (0.779) >> cross-benchmark (0.515). Shared signal exists but per-benchmark probes can't find it independently.
insights.recommendation: Try gradient_aligned features with cross-benchmark intersection.

insights.title: Within-run probe poor on A1
insights.detail: Within-run linear probe AUROC = 0.482 on A1. Probe may be overfitting or feature space is too noisy.
insights.recommendation: Try stronger variance filter or higher L1 regularization.
